info.title: CaseLantern API
info.description: Tenant-scoped JSON API. Select an active tenant using its hostname. Send Accept: application/json and Content-Type: application/json for JSON bodies. Bearer tokens expire after exactly 48 hours; there is no refresh endpoint. Examples are synthetic and do not grant access. See AUTHENTICATION.md for the manual testing guide.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Employee login, current identity, and current-token logout.

tenant.description: Existing active tenant slug; never an employee name or request-body tenant ID.

baseDomain.description: Configured TENANT_BASE_DOMAIN, without scheme, port, or tenant prefix. Replace this placeholder before sending requests.

post.description: Tenant is resolved from the hostname. Issues an opaque token valid for exactly 48 hours, with no refresh or sliding expiration. Five attempts per tenant/email/minute and thirty per IP/minute.

200.description: Authenticated. Raw token is returned only here; response is not cacheable.

422.description: Invalid input. Message text may vary; use the errors object to associate errors with fields.

429.description: Too many login attempts, including successful attempts. Wait for Retry-After seconds before retrying.

get.description: Requires the issued bearer token on the same tenant hostname. Returns current account data, not a capabilities list. No request body. Does not renew the token.

200.description: Current active user; does not extend token expiry

post.description: No request body. Revokes only the presented token. Other device tokens remain valid. Reusing the revoked token, including another logout request, returns 401.

bearerAuth.description: Send Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. This is not a JWT. Cookies, query strings, and body tokens do not authenticate. Tokens are tenant-bound, expire after 48 hours, and fail authentication for inactive/deleted employees or changed passwords.

InvalidCredentials.description: Incorrect email/password or inactive/deleted employee. Unknown accounts receive the same generic error.

Unauthorized.description: Missing/invalid/expired/revoked/wrong-tenant token, inactive/deleted employee, or password changed

NotFound.description: Invalid tenant host, unknown tenant, or disabled tenant
